response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, technically diverse individual contributor with 15+ years of experience including developer tools, testing frameworks, and build/CI infrastructure, but the resume shows no evidence of people management or team leadership responsibilities — all roles are IC titles (Developer, Senior/Staff Developer) with no mention of direct reports, performance reviews, hiring, or leading organizational change. The role requires at least 2 years of people management and 3 years of technical leadership, which are not demonstrated here despite his technical breadth being relevant to the engineering productivity focus area.
strengths: Deep hands-on experience building developer tools, test runners (Trial), assertion libraries, and CI/CD infrastructure
Broad technical range across web, mobile, embedded, and systems programming (DLang, TypeScript, C/C++)
Active public speaker/workshop creator showing ability to share knowledge and mentor informally
concerns: No evidence of formal people management experience (no direct reports, hiring, or performance management mentioned)
Career history is entirely individual-contributor titles despite 'Staff' and 'Senior' labels, with no team-leadership scope described
No mention of mobile-platform ecosystem experience or leading organizational change at scale

key_factors.factor: No demonstrated technical leadership or roadmap ownership at team level
